title: Time Machine and Cover Flow for live HTML
blurb: MacOS Leopard Time Machine, iTunes Cover Flow and Windows Vista Flip 3D for a live editable HTML card, backed by a 16-layer WebGL 2 TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY with zero open ElementImage snapshots, glossy reflections and live interaction on the front card.
question: Can a 16-layer WebGL 2 TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY recreate macOS Leopard Time Machine, iTunes Cover Flow and Windows Vista Flip 3D for a live editing history of HTML states with zero open ElementImage snapshots, glossy reflections and live interaction on the front card?
result: Not verified yet in a live browser. One ElementGL canvas uploads the live editable card with texElementSubImage2D(), copies each saved revision on the GPU into a 16-layer TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY via copyTexSubImage3D(), switches between Time Machine, Cover Flow and Flip 3D with glossy floor reflections, and keeps the front card interactive with updateElementGeometry().
